propositions: The review bot computes per-call token usage (_usage dict) but discards it instead of emitting to CloudWatch, leaving token counts invisible.

finalize.py must aggregate input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_tokens, cache_write_tokens, and total_tokens across all succeeded agent steps (verify and decide) that expose _usage, adding them to coverage.metrics.
voter.py must emit the five token count metrics to CloudWatch Namespace=rebar/host with Unit=Count, using best-effort boto3 put_metric_data that swallows import/credential/network failures.
voter.py must call the token publisher after a successful vote, reading totals from decision[verdict][coverage][metrics], and emit an LLM_TOKEN_USAGE JSON line to stderr/journald as a fallback.
A step record without _usage must contribute 0 tokens and never raise an error, maintaining tolerance across heterogeneous step outputs.
